name: Big Cedar Home
description: Yeti's warm family home is built into the sheltered base of a living cedar without harming the tree.

visual.lighting: Honey morning light through the crescent window and warm practical light at night.
visual.scale_notes: Furniture fits Sasquatches; one low stool and narrow shelf accommodate Tumble.

layout_rules: The crescent window is over the wash basin on the east wall.
The stove sits opposite the window; the central table leaves a clear loop around it.
Yeti and June share a divided loft above the kitchen; Yeti's side is left of the stair.
continuity_locks: The living cedar remains visibly healthy.
The blue kettle and height-mark post remain in the kitchen.
The home is snug, handmade, and comfortably imperfect rather than luxurious.
